claimAll().details: Call this manually to actually get the unstaked BNB back from StakePool after 15 days of withdraw. Claims all the claimable withdraw requests from StakePool. Ignores non-claimable requests.

claimAndDistribute().details: Handy function to both claim the funds from StakePool and distribute it to the users in one go. Might result in out of gas issue, if there are too many withdrawals.

distribute(uint256).details: Anybody can call this, it will always distribute the amount to the original recipients to whom the withdraw was intended.

params.endIdx: the index (exclusive) till which to distribute the funds for withdraw requests

distributeManual(address).details: Anybody can call this to manually send the withdrawn funds to a recipient, if the recipient had funds that need to be manually withdrawn.

initialize(address,address,address,addre.details: initialize function - Constructor for Upgradable contract, can be only called once during deployment

params.addressStore: The contract which holds all the other contract addresses in the stkBNB ecosystem.
params.destination: For our case, its the address of AddressStore contract, as that is constant by design not StakePool.
params.masterVault: Address of the master vault contract
params.rewards: The address to which strategy earnings are transferred

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params.amount: amount of BNB to withdraw returns the amount of stxBNB that will be transfer to recipient

_addressStore.details: The Address Store. Used to fetch addresses of all the other contracts in the stkBNB ecosystem. It is sort of like a router.

_bnbDepositsInStakePool.details: The net amount of BNB deposited to StakePool via this strategy. i.e., the amount deposited - the amount withdrawn. This isn't supposed to include the harvest generated from the pool.

_bnbToDistribute.details: the amount of BNB held by this strategy that needs to be distributed back to the users after withdrawal.

manualWithdrawAmount.details: for storing the withdraw requests that can't be fulfilled via the automated mechanism because of gas limits and have to be manually distributed. It stores the sum of all such requests for a recipient.

withdrawReqs.details: for bookkeeping the withdrawals initiated from this strategy so that they can later be claimed. This mapping always contains reqs between [_startIndex, _endIndex).
